verses.pali: “Dasahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato puggalo na sevitabbo.
verses.english: “Mendicants, you should not associate with an individual who has ten qualities.

verses.pali: Micchādiṭṭhiko hoti, micchāsaṅkappo hoti, micchāvāco hoti, micchākammanto hoti, micchāājīvo hoti, micchāvāyāmo hoti, micchāsati hoti, micchāsamādhi hoti, micchāñāṇī hoti, micchāvimutti hoti—
verses.english: Wrong view, wrong purpose, wrong speech, wrong action, wrong livelihood, wrong effort, wrong mindfulness, wrong immersion, wrong knowledge, and wrong freedom.

verses.pali: imehi kho, bhikkhave, dasahi dhammehi samannāgato puggalo na sevitabbo.
verses.english: You should not associate with an individual who has these ten qualities.

verses.pali: Dasahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato puggalo sevitabbo.
verses.english: You should associate with an individual who has ten qualities.

verses.pali: Sammādiṭṭhiko hoti, sammāsaṅkappo hoti, sammāvāco hoti, sammākammanto hoti, sammāājīvo hoti, sammāvāyāmo hoti, sammāsati hoti, sammāsamādhi hoti, sammāñāṇī hoti, sammāvimutti hoti—
verses.english: Right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, right immersion, right knowledge, and right freedom.

verses.pali: imehi kho, bhikkhave, dasahi dhammehi samannāgato puggalo sevitabbo”ti.
verses.english: You should associate with an individual who has these ten qualities.”
